segments.text: Official tour par government account se air ticket ke liye 2022 order, 3 authorised agents
batata hai. Balmer lorry, Ashok travels and tours aur IRCTC. Entitled class me best available
fare fixed 3R slots se chek kare. Convenience ke liye stated 10% band bhi dekhe. Example,
10am departure ka slot 9-12 hai. Rolling window nahi. Ye air booking rule har rail ticket
par nahi lagta. Unauthorised booking me limited relaxation ke liye competent authority ke
konditions chek kare. 21 days pehle booking encouraged hai. Lekin isse har kies mein Manditri
deadline mat maani hai. Tour ticket departure se less than 72 hours pehle
book ho to self declared reason dena hoga. Example, urgent tour ke ticket doh din pehle
book hu hi to reason taiyaar rakhe. Journey complete hone ke baat 72 hours ke
liye andar prescribed completion certificate bhi dena hai. Donu clocks alag hai. Government
account ke air travel par mileage points generate nahi hone chahiye.
Ab official tour ki daily allowance samjhte hain. Isme teen alak components hain. Eligible
hotel stay, siti ke andar travel aur food ka lump sum. Example, kisi employee ki train
ticket journey fair hain. Hotel, local travel aur food ko alag rule se chek kiya jata hain.
Yaha daily allowance ko salary wali dearness allowance ke saath confuse mat kariye. 2017
order mein listed hotel, food aur kuch travel ceilings dearness allowance ke 50% increase
pat 25% bathe hain. January 2024 se dearness allowance 50% hoa. Example, level 7 ka food base
800 rupees tha. First increase ke baag 1000 rupees banta hain. 50 se 60% jaane par apni aap
ek aur 25% increase mat jodye. Journey date aur latest order chek karen.
First increase ke baat general hotel ceilings per day hain, level 14 aur hooper Rs 9,375,
level 12 se 13 ay 5625, level 9 se 11, 2812 rupees 50 paise, level 6 se 8, 937 rupees 50 paise,
level 5 aur niche 562 rupees 50 paise. Example, level 9 ka eligible room charge Rs 2,000 hain.
Toh seeling badhi hone se poora sealing amount nahi milta. Tax aur proof alak chek karen.
Level 8 aur niche general hotel claim mein, stated conditions per self-certification possible hain.
Stay period aur place jesse details diche.
Class X city mein in levels ke liye special sealing ka 2017 base 1000 tha,
jo first increase ke baat 1250 rupees banta hain.
Is special sealing ke liye relevant voucher chahiye. Example, level 7 ka eligible class
XT voucher ke saath seeling par chek hoga.
2018 order mein tax aur GST sealing se alag hain,
likin GST eligible actual room charge par calculate hoga.
Food ke liye alag bil reimbursement nahi hai. Eligible tour par time ke hi saab se lump sum lagta hai.
Food voucher ki zaroorat nahi hai. First increase ke baad food day reference amounts.
Level 14 aur upar 1500, level 12 se 13 a, 1250, level 9 se 11, 1125, level 6 se 8, 1000
aur level 5 aur niche 625 rupees. Example, level 7 ke liye reference 1000 rupees hai.
Lekin kitna milega ye usi de ki eligible absence par depend kareega. Har midnight to midnight day
par absence al account hoti hai. 6 hour se kum par 30%, 6 se 12 hours par 70% aur 12 hours se
zyada par 100%. Example, level 7 eligible tour ke liye rath 8 paje nikla aur agli subha 5 paje
wapas aaya. Pehle de 4 hours aur 2nd de 5 hours hai. Donu days 30% hai. Pehle de 300
rupees aur 2nd de 300 rupees. Total 600 rupees food amounts chekhoga. Free meals aur baaki
conditions bhi chekh kare.
Tour city travel meh level 14 aur over official need ke hi saab se actual eligible AC Taxi.
Level 12 se 13a ke liye AC Taxi up to 50 km per day.
First increase ke baar non AC daily ceilings, level 9 se 11, 422 rupees 50 paise, level 6 se 8, 281 rupees 25 paise,
level 5 aur niche 141 rupees 25 paise. Example, level 9 ka eligible city taxi expense 300 rupees hai.
To cap 422.50 hoonne se wo automatic flat amount nahi banta.
Level 9 se 11 ke eligible city travel per 2020 order ne voucher ke condition hatai.
Lekin self-certification meh travel period aur vehicle number jaisi detail zarudi hai.
Level 8 aur niche pehle wale self-certification rule ko chek karein.
Example, level 10 employee actual eligible cap cost aur vehicle number sahi record karta hai.
Government ki free car mili ho to uska paid taxi expense nahi bana.
Ye city travel relaxation hotel proof ko automatikli replace nahi karthi.
Official tour per local travel ki reimbursement, actual expense aur baaki konditions per depend karti hai.
DOE ke 2020 clarification ne pay level 9-11 ke liye city travel vouchers ki kondition hatai,
lakin self-certification mein travel period aur vehicle number jaisi details deeni hai.
Example, level 10 employee official visits ke liye cab leeta hai.
Receipt nahi hai toh wo sahi expense aur vehicle number self-certify karta hai.
Applicable limits aur baaki checks abhi bhi zarooni hai.
Free boarding aur lodging milne par bhi, tour ke liye genuinely incurred local travel applicable rules ke hisaap se claim hosakta hai.
Example, Trini ko free hotel aur meals mile, lakin official local trip ka allowed kharch khud diya.
Wo ush kharch ko rules aur evidence ke sakh chek karega.
Level 9-11 ki ye voucher relaxation, hotel, food, transfer ya LTC ke har claim par automatically lagu nahi hoti.
Intercity road journey me pehle check karenge ki concerned state ya neighbouring state ki transport
direct rate ne specific rates prescribed kiye hain ya nahi. Prescribed rates ho to applicable
mode aur pay level ki conditions dekhene. Example, employee apni road journey par vehicle entitlement
aur rail connected route ki fare condition dono check karta hai. Available taxi ka matlab
har pay level ko har taxi class ki entitlement nahi hai. Isi tour city travel wali daily
ceilings hi mix mat kariye. Jaha dono relevant transport direct rates ne rates prescribed nahi
kiye, 2017 fallback onkar ya taxi ke liye 24 aur auto ya on scooter ke liye 12 rupees per
kilometer tha. First 25% increase ke baat ye 30 aur 15 rupees bante hain. Example, otherwise
eligible aur approved onkar journey 40 kilometers hai, to 30 se multiply karne par 1200 rupees
ka starting calculation baneega. Ye calculation vehicle entitlement, route rules aur
baki conditions ko override nahi karta.
Quick official update. Boarding pass missing ho to kya karein?
DOE ka 2020 order central government ki official tour journey ke liye hai.
Agar physical aur digital copy doono nahi hai to prescribed self declaration TA bill ke saath de sakti hai.
Example, level 9 employee apna pass khodeta hai.
Woh actual journey, PNR aur no double claim ki details declaration mein deta hai.
Level 10 aur nechi ki employees ko controlling officer se declaration counter-sign karaana hai.
Ye lost pass declaration journey completion certificate se alag hai.
June 2022 order mein completion certificate journey ke 72 hours ke andar manga gaya hai.
TA bill alag rule se baad me submit huta hai.
Example, employee flight ke baat completion certificate bhijta hai.
Boarding pass nahi mila to bill ke saath alag prescribed declaration lagata hai.
False declaration per disciplinary action aur recovery ho sakti hai.
Transfer TA mein 4 alag heads hain. Employee aur eligible family ki journey.
Composite transfer grant i.e. CTG, personal effects aur eligible conveyance ki transport.
Example, public interest mein approved transfer par employee apne aur family travel.
Saman aur vehicle ko alag rose mein chekk karta hain.
Ek head approve hone se baaki teen heads automatically approve nahi hote.
Transfer wale 2017 order mein stations ke beech 20 km ya zyada doori ho to stated conditions par CTG last basic peka 80%.
Example, eligible transfer mein last basic 50,000 rupees hai to 80% yani 40,000 rupees ka CTG chekk hoga.
Same city ya 20 km se kum distance par actual residence change ho to stated one third rule dekhain.
Own request aur spouse transfer ki restrictions alag hain. Retirement ka 2022 amendment alag hain.
Technical resignation ke liye DOPT ke 2022 consolidated order ko dekhayin.
Proper channel se government post ke liye apply kiya, selection hui aur administrative
reason se resignation dena pada to stated conditions par wo technical ho sakta hai.
Example, employee approved channel se 2stri government post me select hota hai
aur required resignation deta hai. Past service ya baaki benefits alag rules ke conditions
per depend karthein. Har resignation ko technical bol deni se benefits automatic nahi banti.
Usi order ke paragraph 3.6.3 me open competition ya interview se central government
post per appointment ka specific transfer te ye rule hai. Usme temporary central
government employee ki regular continuous service 3 saal se kum ho to transfer te ye
nahi milta. Permanent ya provisionally permanent state employee ke liye bhi paragraph
ki alag wording dekhayin. Example, temporary central employee ki
eisi service 2 saal hai to wo is stated exclusion me ata hai. Baaki cases me
appointment aur service status check karna zarudi hai.
Retirement composite transfer grant, i.e. CTG ke liye DOE ka 6th January 2022 ka amendment
important hai. Retirement ke baat settlement mein 20 kilometer wali condition hatai gai.
Lekin residence ka actual change aur prescribed declaration zaluri hai.
General rate last month's basic pay ka 80% hai, baaki applicable conditions ke saath.
Example, last basic pay Rs. 50,000 ho to eligible full CTG Rs. 40,000 banta hai.
Order apni issue date se effective hai.
Andaman hai Nikobar ya Lakshwadeep island territory se ya vaha qualifying settlement par
order ke mutabik CTG last basic pay ka 100% hai, applicable terms ke saath.
Example, eligible island ke ish mein 50,000 basic pay par ish rate se 50,000 rupees chek honge.
Retirement journey ka TA claim normally journey ke baat 180 days mein diine wali rule
move karne ki eligibility period se alag hai.
Aap poora practical case, level 9 employee eligible official tour par usi de subha aat se
Shyam paach tak bahar hai, eligible train fare 1200 aur actual non-AC city taxi 300 rupees
hai. Free meals ya duplicate claim assume nahi kiye hain. 9 hours ke liye food reference
1125 ka 70% yani 787 rupees 50 paise. Hotel stay nahi hai. Example total 1200 plus 300
plus 787.50 yani 2287 rupees 50 paise. Baaki sanction aur checks ke subject par. Is case
mein return date note karein, ticket aur city travel ki prescribed self-certification rakhhe
aur normally journey ke baat 60 days mein claims submit karein. Example, employee apni train
proof, actual taxi details aur food calculation office ko deta hai. Late claim automatic approved
nahi hota. Is baat ka main focus official travelling allowance hai. LTC ka alag reference guide
mein hai. Baaki transfer, treatment aur special cases ki poori audit aage jari rahi di.
